High Court Sets Aside Order on Foreign Travel Details

The Delhi High Court has set aside an order that directed the disclosure of details regarding the foreign travel of Prime Ministers Narendra Modi and Manmohan Singh. The Central Information Commission (CIC) had previously ordered the disclosure, but the High Court's decision quashes this directive.
